patch: Liraasa 2.0: the great lexicon expansion (grammar untouched; proposed)

summary.growth: listed headwords 1497->1462; listed meanings 3666->4109; plus 1767 image compounds and productive -yo/-vu/-pago/-ti on every root and compound

authority: Rule 0.8:R2: an unused form may receive a gloss only when its compositional meaning is predictable, approved case by case, and recorded in authorized_changes. Ascended glosses (tiers S1, S2) are curated choices in the style of existing entries.
word_building.compounding: a new compound joins exactly two existing headwords, modifier first and head last, and must be flagged as new; its verb class follows its first letter.
word_building.derivations_note: -yo, -vu and -pago attach to the root spelling and take no seven forms.
how_to_apply: 0. This patch changes only the lexicon. The three rule_changes are lexical rulings about what may form a word; no clause, word-order or inflection rule changes.
1b. Apply rule_changes before adding devi, viofuroti, aurumijuba and vanajuba.
2. Review part_1_new_forms and part_2_new_words; delete what you reject.
3c. Apply sense_additions (merged into dictionary_lines) and lexicalised_derivation_updates.
3. Replace each listed headword's line with its line in dictionary_lines.updated_existing.
4. Add dictionary_lines.new_headwords to the dictionary (all flagged {new in 2.0}; file them under whichever domain you like, suggested domain is on each entry).
If you reject an entry, remove it from the matching dictionary line too.
Every spelling was built by word_building rules and checked: nothing collides with an existing headword, form, derivation, or another entry in this patch.
7. Move the headwords in dictionary_lines.demoted_to_pattern out of the dictionary and into a word_building section built from pattern_compounds.

rule_changes.change: Declare devo / devi and nevi / devi as permitted one-edit pairs.
rule_changes.why: new_root_template requires two edits from every active word. devo (faith) and devi (goddess) are a meaningful family pair, like mavo / maivo; nevi is a conjunction and never sits in a noun position.

rule_changes.change: Colour bases may act as the modifier in a dictionary compound, and a compound may be lexicalised with -ti.
rule_changes.why: The colours table already compounds colour bases with headwords (rubijuba, violumi), and -ti is already lexicalised (monruti, soloti). This ruling lets viofuroti exist. It is also used by vanalarnelavra (swan).

rule_changes.change: aurumijuba and vanajuba become dictionary headwords as well as colour words.
rule_changes.why: Gold and silver need forms (golden, silvery) and must be able to join compounds.

rule_changes.change: Image compounds: any listed modifier + any listed head is a valid word with a predictable meaning, no 'new' flag needed (see pattern_compounds).
rule_changes.why: Replaces 391 template headwords with one productive pattern; nothing is deleted, and 1,767 pairings become available instead of 394.

rule_changes.change: Derivations are fully productive with default readings: R+yo = one who does R, or one devoted to R; R+vu = a big or intense R; R+pago = the place of R; R+ti = a little or dear R. They attach to any root or compound (as lemudonuyo and mambiletoyo already do). Listed derivations keep their fixed meanings and override the default.
rule_changes.why: Every root and compound gains an agent, a place and an augmentative without new entries. The listed derivations stay because each fixes a specific English word (sword, library, tavern) rather than the literal default.

reglosses.why: 25 ascended adjectives shared two empty glosses ('hallowed in myth' x16, 'worthy of ancestral reverence' x9). Each now carries a meaning that matches its own ascended noun.

pattern_compounds.name: Image compounds
pattern_compounds.rule: MODIFIER + HEAD, written as one word, where MODIFIER is any root in 'modifiers' and HEAD any root in 'heads'. Meaning: '<modifier adjective> <head>', that is, <head template> <modifier sense>. Example: luno + savali = lunosavali, 'moonlit kiss; an intimate kiss recalling moonlight'. Every such pair is valid Liraasa and needs no 'new' flag. Verb class follows the first letter, as for all compounds.
pattern_compounds.why: 394 dictionary entries followed this exact pattern. Listing them added size but no expressive power, and implied that unlisted pairs (moonlit voice, rain-washed promise) were less valid. As a pattern, all 57 x 31 = 1,767 pairs are available.

reserved_root_bank.note: Short two-syllable roots (consonant-vowel-consonant-vowel) that still fit every rule: at least two edits from every active word in 1.2 plus this patch, and from each other. The most singable root shape is nearly full, so spend these deliberately: on frequent concepts whose words are long. Unassigned; not part of the language until you give one a meaning. Checked against every Liraasa word in the 1.2 file (headwords, forms, small words, numbers, colours, example sentences) and in this patch. Roots with c are left out because its pronunciation is not fixed in the sound section.
